audience: developers and site owners who monitor uptime with updown.io

useCases.title: Check downtime, SSL certificates and domain expiry
useCases.text: The AI gives an overview of all checks: which are down and since when, which have an invalid SSL certificate, and which certificates or domains expire soon.

useCases.title: Report uptime and response times of a site
useCases.text: The AI reads a check's uptime, apdex and timings over a time range. Timings can also be grouped by time or by monitoring location, without uptime.

useCases.title: List the downtimes of a check
useCases.text: The AI lists a check's downtimes with error, start, end and duration. You see which checks had problems and for how long.

useCases.title: Add a check or change an existing one
useCases.text: The AI creates a new check for a URL or heartbeat, or changes the URL, period, alias or alert recipients of a check, pauses it or mutes its alerts.

useCases.title: Set up alert recipients and a status page
useCases.text: The AI adds an alert recipient such as an email or Slack webhook, and creates or updates a status page that shows chosen checks.
